summary: Frontend-only regression on the Scripture tab (self-paced progression). All 4 required scenarios PASS at 390x844 against http://localhost:3000/scripture with backend https://exodus-build-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. GET /api/daily-verse never advances the user's day; only POST /api/daily-verse/complete does. Guests can complete locally but the server writes no progress (status='guest', progress=null).

scenarios.name: Opening tab does not advance progress
scenarios.evidence: Fresh signed-in user; three page.reload() cycles — headline stays 'Today's Reading · Day 1' every load. Direct in-browser fetch of GET /api/daily-verse with Bearer token returned day=1 and progress.last_completed_date=null. Zero POST /api/daily-verse/complete requests observed during passive viewing.

scenarios.name: Tap Mark Today's Reading Complete advances
scenarios.evidence: Opened passage via scripture-passage-toggle, clicked scripture-mark-complete-button. Completion card (scripture-completion-card) appeared. Headline stayed 'Day 1' pre-reload (spec: keep completed passage visible until next visit). Exactly one POST /api/daily-verse/complete with body {"day":1,"local_date":"2026-07-29"} returned 200. After page.reload(), headline advanced to 'Today's Reading · Day 2'.

scenarios.name: Save reflection also advances
scenarios.evidence: Fresh signed-in user typed 39-char reflection into scripture-reflection-input, clicked scripture-save-reflection-button. Completion card appeared. Exactly one POST /api/daily-verse/complete observed (200). After page.reload(), headline advanced to 'Today's Reading · Day 2'.

scenarios.name: Guests never write server progress
scenarios.evidence: Fresh incognito context (no auth). Headline 'Today's Reading · Day 1', progress label 'Your journey has begun'. Tapped passage toggle, clicked Mark Complete — completion card appeared locally. POST /api/daily-verse/complete fired once and response body was { status: 'guest', progress: null }. Unauthenticated GET /api/daily-verse afterwards returned progress: null (no phantom server row created).

notes: In Scenario 4 the RN-web Pressable did not respond to the first Playwright force-click on the passage toggle for the guest run; a JS-dispatched click sequence (pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click) was used as a fallback. This is a test-harness quirk on react-native-web + Playwright, not an app bug — signed-in scenarios 2 & 3 clicked the same toggle successfully on first try. The test now retries via dispatchEvent when the first click fails, so it is deterministic.
Auth was seeded via window.localStorage['prayersloft_auth_v1'] as documented in /app/frontend/src/lib/auth-store.ts; UI sign-in was not required for these functional checks.
The mark-complete API request payload uses `local_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) with no `tz` (client omits `tz` when it is undefined — this matches api.ts:completeDailyReading).
critical_code_review_comments: scripture.tsx (line ~172): api.completeDailyReading(...) is fire-and-forget with catch → console.warn. This is intentional per the code comments and matches the spec ('keep the completed passage visible until next visit'). No change needed.

api.ts:completeDailyReading — request body is JSON.stringify({day, local_date, tz}); tz is passed as undefined in scripture.tsx call, so it's omitted from the JSON payload. Backend must remain tolerant of missing tz (server-side pytest coverage already confirms this).
seed_data_creation: 3 fresh users registered via POST /api/auth/register with pattern canonprog_<uuid>@prayersloft-qa.com and password TestPass123!. Emails are randomised per run so no cleanup is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright installed via pip + `playwright install chromium`. Reusable regression script at /app/test_reports/scripture_selfpaced_test.py — runs headless and prints PASS/FAIL for each of the 4 scenarios plus writes /app/test_reports/scripture_selfpaced_results.json. Register endpoint returns tokens nested under `tokens.{access_token,refresh_token}`; helper flattens this. The auth-store localStorage key is prayersloft_auth_v1.
rca_of_issue: N/A — self-paced Scripture regression verified; no bugs found.
